listing.name: Autosave Extended
listing.summary: Adds automatic saving at specific game events like jumping, trading, and after battles.
listing.aiSummary: Adds automatic saving at specific game events like jumping, trading, and after battles.

description:
I wanted an updated version of

autosave

so I created my own version of it.

Requirements

LazyLib

v3.0

LunaLib

v2.0.3

Currently, this includes the following autosaves:

On jumpOn transactionAfter battle

The mod uses the new autosave slots for autosaves and includes the option to create a normal save after a specific period.

By default, all autosaves are enabled, and normal saves are disabled, but they can all be configured from Luna settings.
descriptionHtml:
I wanted an updated version of autosave so I created my own version of it.





Requirements
LazyLib v3.0
LunaLib v2.0.3

Currently, this includes the following autosaves:
  • On jump
  • On transaction
  • After battle
The mod uses the new autosave slots for autosaves and includes the option to create a normal save after a specific period.
By default, all autosaves are enabled, and normal saves are disabled, but they can all be configured from Luna settings.
aiDescription: Provides an updated version of the original autosave mod with support for new save slots. It allows players to configure autosaves for jumps, transactions, and post-battle states, and includes an option to create normal saves after a set period.
